prototypeScope: V1.30 delta package (D-023): one White plate with the U20 face panel, one Black plate with the U20 eye trim and the jaw support, one Yellow plate with the lower head shell. The face and trim take the Innomaker U20CAM-720P USB camera; the jaw support and the shell open the left-rear head exit to dia 11 so the camera cable leaves the head whole. All four replace printed parts. The head cap is not reprinted; the four V1.9 wire clips are retired unfitted.
knownFitBoundary: Camera dimensions (lens seat 5.5, lens 15.4, ring dia 15.1, connector 10 x 4.5 x 3) are read off the product renders and the Innomaker manual, not measured: only a lens height of 12 mm or less would clip the field (checks.json sensitivityToLensHeight); confirm with calipers on the OMX arm camera before the camera goes on. Boss pilots dia 1.7 for M2 x 6 (4.4 mm of thread); the trim bore dia 16.2 is 0.55 mm clear of the lens ring. The exit parts: the moved M2.6 seat and the tie window are new, not yet printed; the camera cable diameter (4 mm) is assumed. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: V1.17 White overrides kept for the face (3 support interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer); the face prints flat and needs no support. Black and Yellow: donor profiles as is (as V1.8 and V1.28).

parts.changeReason: D-023 (2026-10-22): the Innomaker U20CAM-720P USB camera takes the four face bosses. The bosses grow from 4.0 to 7.7 mm (dia 4.8, pilot dia 1.7, wall 1.55) so the camera PCB sits 2.2 mm behind the lens holder seat and the M12 lens front lands 1.6 mm behind the trim front; the eye opening grows to dia 16.2 for the dia 15.1 lens ring, with the same 45 deg flare outside. Front face otherwise unchanged (checks.json frontUnchangedOutsideBore). Four M2 x 6 into the bosses (C-camera-01..04), 4.4 mm of thread. The two side key pockets for the eye-trim tabs at (AY -/+ 7.7, AZ - 4.5) are filled through the 1.3 mm front skin: the bore cut into them, leaving 0.35 mm; the trim loses its two side tabs and the top key pair stays.
